CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a crane-down descending from overhead into a level medium on an 8mm circular fisheye, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
